scripts.dev:web: npm run sync:data && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:api: npm run sync:data && cd backend && ./venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev: npm run sync:data && npx concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:web: npm run sync:data && npm run build --prefix frontend
